root.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Accepted: Ryder Gambit
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 exf3 5. Qxf3

overview: White recaptures on f3 with the queen and leaves the d4 pawn en prise: after 5...Qxd4 6.Be3 Qg4 the queens may be swapped and White hopes for development and attack for a pawn or two. Black can grab d4 and reach a comfortable extra pawn after careful play, or decline with ...e6 or ...Nc6. It is a rare, speculative gambit.

white_ideas.idea: Lead in development with Be3, O-O-O and Bd3 after Black takes d4.
Put pressure on f7 and the kingside with Qf3 and Bc4.

black_ideas.idea: Take the d4 pawn and bring the queen back to safety.
Develop with ...e6, ...Be7 and return material for a safe position.

typical_structures.structure: White gets open e- and f-files with Black's queen sometimes exposed in the centre.

character.notes: White is a pawn or two down for development; early tactics against the Black queen decide.

gambit.notes: Black can keep material, and taking d4 as well leaves two extra pawns.

soundness.notes: The Blackmar-Diemer family is considered unsound at the top, and this branch with d4 hanging is worse.

structure.notes: Open centre with e- and d-file lines.

approach.notes: Strong players almost never choose the BDG, the Ryder even less.

level.notes: Relies on knowing the traps; unsound lines are not a good first repertoire.

sublines_that_differ.name: Tejler Gambit line
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 exf3 5. Qxf3 Qxd4 6. Be3 Qg4 7. Qf2 Ne4
sublines_that_differ.how: Black grabs d4 and offers a queen trade; it is the critical test.

character.reason: A gambit with an exposed Black queen and early tactics.

gambit.reason: White is a pawn down and Black can keep it.

soundness.reason: Strong players consider the BDG, and especially this branch, unsound.

structure.reason: The centre opens quickly and pieces play on open lines.

approach.reason: Strong players hardly ever play the BDG.

level.reason: Dubious lines are never beginner, and it relies on known traps.

plans.reason: White's compensation is pieces out and open lines against the Black king.
